Haste · Food journal

Log a meal in the time
it takes to say it.

Snap a photo, say it out loud or type it. Haste estimates calories and macros, you check the numbers, and your streak keeps going.

Drag to rotate

  1. 01 · Capture

    Snap, say or type.

    One capture screen for photos, voice, text, barcodes and manual entry. Pick whatever is quickest right now.

  2. 02 · Journal

    Your day at a glance.

    Calories and macros add up as you go. Edit a meal, repeat a favourite, or jump to any day on the calendar.

  3. 03 · Progress

    Trends, not guilt.

    Weigh-ins, weekly and monthly trends and a streak that rewards showing up, with freezes for the days life gets in the way.

Snap, say or type

Photo, voice, text, barcode or manual. AI estimates calories, protein, carbs and fat, and shows how sure it is.

Voice stays on your phone

Speech is transcribed on-device with Whisper. Your recording never leaves the phone.

You have the final say

Every estimate goes through a review screen. Unknown values stay blank, never zero.

469cited NZ servings

Food search, made for NZ

Cited servings for New Zealand products and restaurants, plus USDA and Open Food Facts. Barcodes decode on-device.

Streaks with freezes

Consistency over perfection. A freeze covers the day you couldn’t log.

Friends, if you want

Cheer each other on. Friends see your streak, never your meals, weight or photos.

Your data, your call

No ads and no tracking. Export your journal or delete your account from Settings.

Home-screen widgets

On Android: a streak counter and one-tap shortcuts to capture, scan or dictate.

Concept VST Pedal · Hardware

Your plug-ins.
On the floor.

A concept for a stompbox that runs your Windows VST plug-ins, so the sound you dialled in at the desk comes to the gig without a laptop.

Turn a knob · Stomp the switch · Drag to look around

Synthesised live in your browser with the Web Audio API. A sketch of the feel, not a VST host. Yet.

  1. 01Now

    Concept

    Define the idea, the player and the questions worth answering.

  2. 02

    Feasibility

    Measure latency and plug-in hosting on candidate hardware.

  3. 03

    Prototype

    A working bench prototype with real controls.

  4. 04

    On stage

    Field testing with players in real rigs.

Inside the idea: latency, hosting and the hard questions

The studio

Built one idea
at a time.

Kokonut is a small, independent studio. I design, build and ship everything here myself, from the database schema to the last pixel, and I’d rather make one thing properly than five things halfway.

Right now that means Haste, and a guitar pedal I can’t stop thinking about.

Private by default

No ads, no trackers, no analytics on this site. Voice stays on the device. Data leaves your phone only when a feature needs it.

Fast is a feature

If logging a meal takes longer than eating it, people stop. Every screen is designed around the fewest taps.

Honest about what’s ready

Testing means testing. Concepts are labelled as concepts. Estimates are shown as estimates.
